objective: Test whether a lightweight position-aware time-frequency patch branch adds stable animal-level age-classification information beyond the tuned frozen-AST global embedding.

relationship.idea056: defines the tuned frozen-AST reference and animal-level validation cross-entropy checkpoint rule
relationship.ast_internal_diagnosis: provides the middle-frequency and middle-time located signals
relationship.idea052: provides the audited frozen-feature training and complete-OOF evaluation framework
relationship.stage: IDEA-057 independent initial validation before any IDEA-057/IDEA-058 combination

dataset.local_representation: nine 768-dimensional call representations from a 3 x 3 relative frequency-time grid

feature_preparation.time_partition: three relative groups over valid AST time positions; an empty short-call group reuses its nearest valid position
feature_preparation.frequency_partition: three contiguous relative groups over the 12 AST frequency positions
feature_preparation.cell_pooling: mean final-layer patch token within each frequency-time cell, followed by arithmetic mean across segments belonging to one call

middle_frequency_strip.selected_cells: all three relative-time cells in the middle relative-frequency band
middle_frequency_strip.position_readout: ordered concatenation followed by a linear 96 -> 128 map

full_3x3_grid.selected_cells: all nine relative frequency-time cells in row-major frequency-time order
full_3x3_grid.position_readout: ordered concatenation followed by a linear 144 -> 128 map

inner_selection.selection_rule: highest mean inner-validation animal Macro F1 across 12 splits; ties within 1e-6 use lower mean animal cross-entropy, then fewer trainable parameters, then lexical recipe ID

R0_tuned_frozen_ast.architecture: standardized global 768 -> 128 -> 3 head with ReLU, BatchNorm and dropout

M1_position_aware_local_patch.architecture: R0 global path plus the selected ordered local-grid branch and a zero-initialized 128-dimensional residual gate
M1_position_aware_local_patch.local_input: selected time-frequency cells retain their fixed relative positions

C1_position_removed_control.architecture: identical to M1 with exactly the same trainable parameters
C1_position_removed_control.local_input: the mean of all nine cells is repeated at every selected position
C1_position_removed_control.role: capacity-matched control with local position removed

fixed_training.call_weighting: fixed global class-balanced call weights from the current training role
fixed_training.global_normalization: training-call global embedding mean and standard deviation per fit
fixed_training.local_normalization: all nine grid cells from training calls per fit

bootstrap.method: paired cat-cluster bootstrap for each pipeline contrast

seed_expansion_gate.action_when_met: freeze the selected IDEA-057 recipe and expand matched R0/M1/C1 to base seeds 43 and 101
seed_expansion_gate.action_when_not_met: close IDEA-057 as a structured local-patch mechanism ablation and continue independently to IDEA-058
